title: How Much Does Grooming Salon Marketing Cost? | Perform Pets

facts.fact: The page states that grooming salon marketing from an agency that works with pet businesses costs about $750 to $5,000 or more a month for ongoing work in 2026.
facts.quote: costs about $750 to $5,000 or more a month for ongoing work in 2026

facts.fact: The page says its published agency prices were checked on October 14, 2026, and come only from the three agencies that publish prices.
facts.quote: those figures come from the three that do, checked on October 14, 2026

facts.fact: The page says the listed prices are the range those agencies list and are not an industry average.
facts.quote: They are the range those agencies list, not an industry average

facts.fact: TailWerks lists an ongoing multi-channel package at $997 to $3,247 a month across three tiers, with entry requirements on the top tier.
facts.quote: $997 to $3,247 a month across three tiers; the top tier has entry requirements

facts.fact: Perform Pets lists an ongoing multi-channel package from $2,000 a month for one location.
Pet Engine Marketing lists an ongoing partnership generally from $2,500 a month.
Paw Point Marketing does not publish a management fee for its paid ads program and requires at least $600 a month in ad spend.
facts.quote: requires at least $600 a month in ad spend

facts.fact: The page states that ad spend is not included in any of the listed agency monthly fees.
facts.quote: Ad spend is not included in any of these fees.

facts.fact: Perform Pets lists a one-time website build at $3,000.
Perform Pets's website service card states the website goes live in 45 days for $4,500 flat, which differs from the $3,000 build price listed elsewhere on the page.
Pet Marketing Unleashed lists a branded website build from $7,600 as a one-time cost.
MoeGo lists its mobile grooming booking software plans at $49 to $159 a month, with higher plans priced per van.
facts.quote: $49 to $159 a month; the higher plans are priced per van

facts.fact: Perform Pets's growth strategy service is described as limited slots on a month-to-month basis.
